text.en: Claude Code 2.1.328, dated 19 November 2026, adds auto mode on Bedrock, Google Cloud and Foundry, and lets failing mcp_tool hooks block the action, according to its changelog.
text.es: Claude Code 2.1.328, del 19 de noviembre de 2026, añade el modo auto en Bedrock, Google Cloud y Foundry, y permite que un hook mcp_tool que falla bloquee la acción, según su changelog.
text.ca: Claude Code 2.1.328, del 19 de novembre de 2026, afegeix el mode auto a Bedrock, Google Cloud i Foundry, i permet que un hook mcp_tool que falla bloquegi l'acció, segons el seu changelog.

text.en: Kiro IDE 1.4.236, dated 18 November 2026, lets a script answer permission prompts through hooks and adds organization sign-in for MCP servers, according to its changelog.
text.es: Kiro IDE 1.4.236, del 18 de noviembre de 2026, permite que un script responda a las peticiones de permiso mediante hooks y añade inicio de sesión de organización para servidores MCP, según su changelog.
text.ca: Kiro IDE 1.4.236, del 18 de novembre de 2026, permet que un script respongui a les peticions de permís mitjançant hooks i afegeix inici de sessió d'organització per a servidors MCP, segons el seu changelog.

text.en: Grok Bot v1.2.3, dated 18 November 2026, lets users choose per tool on connector pages: Always allow, Auto-review, Needs approval or Blocked, according to its changelog.
text.es: Grok Bot v1.2.3, del 18 de noviembre de 2026, permite elegir por herramienta en las páginas de conectores: Always allow, Auto-review, Needs approval o Blocked, según su changelog.
text.ca: Grok Bot v1.2.3, del 18 de novembre de 2026, permet triar per eina a les pàgines de connectors: Always allow, Auto-review, Needs approval o Blocked, segons el seu changelog.

text.en: GHSA-2m9m-6cr5-9x25, in OSV on 19 November 2026: write tools of the npm package mssql-mcp-core pass unparameterized table names and WHERE clauses, allowing SQL injection, according to OSV.
text.es: GHSA-2m9m-6cr5-9x25, en OSV el 19 de noviembre de 2026: las herramientas de escritura del paquete npm mssql-mcp-core pasan nombres de tabla y cláusulas WHERE sin parametrizar, lo que permite inyección SQL, según OSV.
text.ca: GHSA-2m9m-6cr5-9x25, a OSV el 19 de novembre de 2026: les eines d'escriptura del paquet npm mssql-mcp-core passen noms de taula i clàusules WHERE sense parametritzar, cosa que permet injecció SQL, segons OSV.

text.en: CVE-2026-132121, in NVD on 18 November 2026: Supergateway 2.4.0 through 4.2.2 in stdio-to-WebSocket mode does not check the Origin header, so web pages can open MCP sessions, according to NVD.
text.es: CVE-2026-132121, en NVD el 18 de noviembre de 2026: Supergateway 2.4.0 a 4.2.2 en modo stdio-to-WebSocket no comprueba la cabecera Origin, así que una página web puede abrir sesiones MCP, según NVD.
text.ca: CVE-2026-132121, a NVD el 18 de novembre de 2026: Supergateway 2.4.0 a 4.2.2 en mode stdio-to-WebSocket no comprova la capçalera Origin, així que una pàgina web pot obrir sessions MCP, segons NVD.

held.text_en: VS Code 1.147, dated 18 November 2026, adds a preview browser integration that lets agents control the default browser, according to its release notes.
GitHub Copilot's changelog of 18 November 2026 adds connectors for Supabase, Box, Calendly and other services to Copilot.
Qoder CN CLI 1.1.92, dated 18 November 2026, fixes text passed through heredoc being flagged as a dangerous command, according to its changelog.
CVE-2026-63129, in NVD on 18 November 2026: mssql-mcp-core before 0.6.0 interpolates caller-controlled identifiers and predicates into T-SQL batches, according to NVD.
CVE-2026-130764, in NVD on 18 November 2026: Obot 0.8.0 before 0.27.0 can be led to internal hosts by a remote MCP server's OAuth token endpoint, according to NVD.
CVE-2026-130766, in NVD on 18 November 2026: Obot 0.26.0 before 0.27.0 does not validate the resource identifier in remote MCP server metadata, according to NVD.
CVE-2026-130767, in NVD on 18 November 2026: Obot 0.9.0 before 0.27.0 allows command injection through file-type MCP server configuration values, according to NVD.
CVE-2026-130768, in NVD on 18 November 2026: Obot 0.14.0 before 0.27.0 lets remote MCP servers point to unspecified or IPv6 transition addresses, according to NVD.
CVE-2026-130711, in NVD on 18 November 2026: NocoDB before 2026.09.0 lets an MCP token id resolve roles against another base, according to NVD.
CVE-2026-76807, in NVD on 18 November 2026: Todoist MCP Server before 10.3.3 does not validate Host and Origin on POST /mcp in its HTTP server, according to NVD.
CVE-2026-77283, in NVD on 18 November 2026: obsidian-sync-mcp before 0.5.7 without MCP_AUTH_TOKEN does not authenticate its HTTP /mcp endpoint, according to NVD.
CVE-2026-75612, in NVD on 18 November 2026: yt-mcp before 1.18.1 reads and uploads any caller-chosen file through add_attachment, according to NVD.
CVE-2026-62964, in NVD on 18 November 2026: Gortex before 0.55.0 lets MCP file tools write outside indexed repository roots, according to NVD.
CVE-2026-75518, in NVD on 18 November 2026: the DOMShell MCP server before 2.0.8 treats domshell_eval as a read-tier tool, according to NVD.
CVE-2026-130750, in NVD on 18 November 2026: Network-AI 5.11.0 before 5.17.2 reflects localhost Origins in McpStreamableServer CORS headers, according to NVD.
CVE-2026-18399, in NVD on 18 November 2026: several Mattermost versions do not enforce the GitLab group restriction in the get_projects MCP tool, according to NVD.
CVE-2026-119220, in NVD on 18 November 2026: the Dokan WordPress plugin up to 5.3.3 matches its MCP endpoint with an unanchored expression, allowing authorization bypass, according to NVD.
GitHub Copilot CLI 1.0.113, dated 17 November 2026, lets administrators disable built-in Browser Use with the managed setting features.browserUse, according to its changelog.

Qoder CN CLI 1.1.91, dated 17 November 2026, lets enterprise administrators distribute Skills and MCP to members, and Auto mode sends only high-risk commands to model approval, according to its changelog.
MAL-2026-20101, in OSV on 17 November 2026, lists the PyPI package agent-framework as malicious code, according to OSV.
MAL-2026-20068, in OSV on 17 November 2026, lists the PyPI package mcp-aevo-server as malicious code, according to OSV.
CVE-2026-130796, in NVD on 17 November 2026: Flowise 3.1.3 through 3.1.4 lets unauthenticated users read MCP server bearer tokens from a public chatflow endpoint, according to NVD.

CVE-2026-130121, in NVD on 18 November 2026: the AI Puffer MCP Server WordPress plugin up to 2.5.28 stores unsanitized AI-generated comment replies, allowing stored cross-site scripting, according to NVD.
